description.desc_thousand_char: Anuspa Heritage Products Private Limited (AHPPL) was formerly known as Anuraah Soap Private Limited. As per its credit ratings, the company is engaged in manufacturing soap cakes, and 80 percent revenue is derived from contract manufacturing, while the rest is from its brands, Anuspaa and Anuved. Its two manufacturing facilities are located in Parwanoo, Himachal Pradesh.  It has produced over 1000+ types of soaps of different shapes and formulae. The company's partners include Mama Earth, Dmart, Glenmark, Khadi India, FDC, and Sun Pharma. The company was incorporated in 1999 and its registered office is located in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.
